an10.222:1.1: Vīsatiyā bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an10.222:1.3: Attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti, parañ ca pāṇātipāte samādapeti;
an10.222:1.4: attanā ca adinnādāyī hoti, parañ ca adinnādāne samādapeti;
an10.222:1.5: attanā ca kāmesu micchācārī hoti, parañ ca kāmesu micchācāre samādapeti;
an10.222:1.6: attanā ca musāvādī hoti, parañ ca musāvāde samādapeti;
an10.222:1.7: attanā ca pisunāvāco hoti, parañ ca pisunāya vācāya samādapeti;
an10.222:1.8: attanā ca pharusāvāco hoti, parañ ca pharusāya vācāya samādapeti;
an10.222:1.9: attanā ca samphappalāpī hoti, parañ ca samphappalāpe samādapeti;
an10.222:1.10: attanā ca abhijjhālu hoti, parañ ca abhijjhāya samādapeti;
an10.222:1.11: attanā ca vyāpannacitto hoti, parañ ca vyāpāde samādapeti;
an10.222:1.12: attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañ ca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti.
an10.222:1.13: Imehi kho bhikkhave vīsatiyā dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 3.
an10.222:2.1: Vīsatiyā bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an10.222:2.3: Attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
an10.222:2.4: attanā ca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
an10.222:2.5: attanā ca kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
an10.222:2.6: attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
an10.222:2.7: attanā ca pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca pisunāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti,
an10.222:2.8: attanā ca pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
an10.222:2.9: attanā ca samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, parañ ca samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā samādapeti;
an10.222:2.10: attanā ca anabhijjhālu hoti, parañ ca anabhijjhāya samādapeti;
an10.222:2.11: attanā ca avyāpannacitto hoti, parañ ca avyāpāde samādapeti;
an10.222:2.12: attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañ ca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti.
an10.222:2.13: Imehi kho bhikkhave vīsatiyā dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. 1.
